question: I need you to look into the actor collaborations and tell me how many actors have made more films with Yash Chopra than with any other director. This will help us understand his influence on the industry better.
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) as result
FROM (
    WITH actor_yash_counts AS (
        SELECT M_Cast.PID as actor_pid, COUNT(*) as films_with_yash
        FROM M_Cast
        JOIN M_Director ON M_Cast.MID = M_Director.MID
        WHERE M_Director.PID = 'nm0007181'
        GROUP BY M_Cast.PID
    ),
    actor_max_other_counts AS (
        SELECT actor_pid, MAX(film_count) as max_films_with_other_director
        FROM (
            SELECT M_Cast.PID as actor_pid, M_Director.PID as director_pid, COUNT(*) as film_count
            FROM M_Cast
            JOIN M_Director ON M_Cast.MID = M_Director.MID
            WHERE M_Director.PID != 'nm0007181'
            GROUP BY M_Cast.PID, M_Director.PID
        )
        GROUP BY actor_pid
    )
    SELECT ay.actor_pid
    FROM actor_yash_counts ay
    LEFT JOIN actor_max_other_counts amoc ON ay.actor_pid = amoc.actor_pid
    WHERE ay.films_with_yash > COALESCE(amoc.max_films_with_other_director, 0)
)
